text: You might know the Chinese zodiac from a placemat at a Chinese restaurant.
shown: You might know the Chinese zodiac from a placemat at a Chinese restaurant.

text: From Beijing to Seoul, from Tokyo to Singapore, the fourth animal is the rabbit.
shown: From Beijing to Seoul, from Tokyo to Singapore, the fourth animal is the rabbit.

text: In Vietnam... it's a cat.
shown: In Vietnam... it's a cat.

text: In Vietnam, you're a cat.
shown: In Vietnam, you're a cat.

text: In the next few minutes: why the zodiac isn't really about animals, why the famous explanation may be wrong, and why Vietnam's cat was once a corrupt official.
shown: In the next few minutes: why the zodiac isn't really about animals, why the famous explanation may be wrong, and why Vietnam's cat was once a corrupt official.

text: Surprise one: the zodiac isn't really about animals.
shown: Surprise one: the zodiac isn't really about animals.

text: It started as a clock and a compass.
shown: It started as a clock and a compass.

text: Each of the twelve signs marks a two-hour slot of the day, a month, and a direction.
shown: Each of the twelve signs marks a two-hour slot of the day, a month, and a direction.

text: The fourth sign means five to seven in the morning, mid-spring, and due east.
shown: The fourth sign means five to seven in the morning, mid-spring, and due east.

text: Its character isn't even the Chinese word for rabbit.
shown: Its character isn't even the Chinese word for rabbit.

text: The animals were just memory aids... stickers on a clock.
shown: The animals were just memory aids... stickers on a clock.

text: A Vietnamese grandmother might still say a baby was born in the hour of the cat.
shown: A Vietnamese grandmother might still say a baby was born in the hour of the cat.

text: Once you see them as stickers, the differences across Asia make sense.
shown: Once you see them as stickers, the differences across Asia make sense.

text: Korea kept China's stickers.
shown: Korea kept China's stickers.

text: Japan swapped the pig for a wild boar, an animal it actually had in its forests.
shown: Japan swapped the pig for a wild boar, an animal it actually had in its forests.

text: Thailand turned the dragon into a naga, the great serpent you see guarding its temples.
shown: Thailand turned the dragon into a naga, the great serpent you see guarding its temples.

text: Among some Tai peoples, from northern Thailand to southern China, the pig even becomes an elephant.
shown: Among some Tai peoples, from northern Thailand to southern China, the pig even becomes an elephant.

text: Everyone put their own animals on the clock.
shown: Everyone put their own animals on the clock.

text: But Thailand and Cambodia still kept the rabbit.
shown: But Thailand and Cambodia still kept the rabbit.

text: Among all of Vietnam's neighbors... only Vietnam has a cat.
shown: Among all of Vietnam's neighbors... only Vietnam has a cat.

text: And the eighth sign?
shown: And the eighth sign?

text: Japan calls it the sheep.
shown: Japan calls it the sheep.

text: Vietnam calls it the goat.
shown: Vietnam calls it the goat.

text: That matters soon.
shown: That matters soon.

text: 2027 is that year... a sheep in Tokyo, a goat in Hanoi.
shown: 2027 is that year... a sheep in Tokyo, a goat in Hanoi.

text: Vietnam made a swap too... or did it?
shown: Vietnam made a swap too... or did it?

text: You'll often read that Vietnam replaced the ox with a water buffalo.
shown: You'll often read that Vietnam replaced the ox with a water buffalo.

text: But the Chinese character for this sign covers cattle in general, including the water buffalo.
shown: But the Chinese character for this sign covers cattle in general, including the water buffalo.

text: So Vietnam may not have replaced anything at all.
shown: So Vietnam may not have replaced anything at all.

text: It simply pictured the animal pulling ploughs through its own rice fields.
shown: It simply pictured the animal pulling ploughs through its own rice fields.

text: And here's a twist.
shown: And here's a twist.

text: Some linguists, starting with Jerry Norman in 1985, have suggested that the ancient name of this sign may come from an old word for buffalo in the Austroasiatic languages, the family Vietnamese belongs to.
shown: Some linguists, starting with Jerry Norman in 1985, have suggested that the ancient name of this sign may come from an old word for buffalo in the Austroasiatic languages, the family Vietnamese belongs to.

text: It's a theory, not a fact.
shown: It's a theory, not a fact.

text: But if it's right, the buffalo may have been there from the very start.
shown: But if it's right, the buffalo may have been there from the very start.

text: Now, the cat.
shown: Now, the cat.

text: In 2023, while most of Asia welcomed the Year of the Rabbit, cat statues filled Vietnam's streets and shopping malls.
shown: In 2023, while most of Asia welcomed the Year of the Rabbit, cat statues filled Vietnam's streets and shopping malls.

text: Surprise two: the famous explanation for that cat may be wrong.
shown: Surprise two: the famous explanation for that cat may be wrong.

text: Many articles say the Chinese name of this sign sounds like the Vietnamese word for cat.
shown: Many articles say the Chinese name of this sign sounds like the Vietnamese word for cat.

text: NPR pointed out that's not exactly true.
shown: NPR pointed out that's not exactly true.

text: But here's another theory that may fit better.
shown: But here's another theory that may fit better.

text: In Vietnamese, this character has two readings.
shown: In Vietnamese, this character has two readings.

text: The scholarly one is "mow".
shown: The scholarly one is "Mao".

text: The everyday one is "meh-oh".
shown: The everyday one is "Meo".

text: People would say someone was born in the year of meh-oh.
shown: People would say someone was born in the year of Meo.

text: And that sounds almost exactly like "meh-oh"... the Vietnamese word for cat.
shown: And that sounds almost exactly like "meo"... the Vietnamese word for cat.

text: Add a rice-growing country full of rats, where cats were useful and rabbits were rare, and the switch feels natural.
shown: Add a rice-growing country full of rats, where cats were useful and rabbits were rare, and the switch feels natural.

text: Still, no one knows exactly when it happened.
shown: Still, no one knows exactly when it happened.

text: Older Vietnamese texts still mention the rabbit.
shown: Older Vietnamese texts still mention the rabbit.

text: Surprise three.
shown: Surprise three.

text: You may know the legend of the Great Race.
shown: You may know the legend of the Great Race.

text: The rat tricks the cat, the cat misses the zodiac... and that's why cats chase rats.
shown: The rat tricks the cat, the cat misses the zodiac... and that's why cats chase rats.

text: In Vietnam, the story often ends differently: the cat swims across the river and takes fourth place.
shown: In Vietnam, the story often ends differently: the cat swims across the river and takes fourth place.

text: But if you think Vietnam chose the cat because it's cute and lucky...
shown: But if you think Vietnam chose the cat because it's cute and lucky...

text: ...meet one of the most famous cats in Vietnamese art.
shown: ...meet one of the most famous cats in Vietnamese art.

text: This is "The Rat's Wedding", a woodblock print from dong haw village, traditionally hung for Tet, Vietnam's Lunar New Year.
shown: This is "The Rat's Wedding", a woodblock print from Dong Ho village, traditionally hung for Tet, Vietnam's Lunar New Year.

text: The rats are getting married.
shown: The rats are getting married.

text: But first, the old rats must bow to the cat and offer gifts: a bird, a fish.
shown: But first, the old rats must bow to the cat and offer gifts: a bird, a fish.

text: The cat is not a pet here.
shown: The cat is not a pet here.

text: Folk artists drew him as a powerful official, and the rats as the poor who must pay him off to stay safe.
shown: Folk artists drew him as a powerful official, and the rats as the poor who must pay him off to stay safe.

text: A New Year picture... about bribery.
shown: A New Year picture... about bribery.

text: A Vietnamese folk rhyme goes like this.
shown: A Vietnamese folk rhyme goes like this.

text: "The cat climbs the areca tree, asking where Mister Mouse has gone. Mister Mouse has gone to the far market, to buy salt and fish sauce for the cat's father's memorial."
shown: "The cat climbs the areca tree, asking where Mister Mouse has gone. Mister Mouse has gone to the far market, to buy salt and fish sauce for the cat's father's memorial."

text: On the surface, it's polite.
shown: On the surface, it's polite.

text: Underneath, it's a joke about the powerful pretending to be kind to the weak.
shown: Underneath, it's a joke about the powerful pretending to be kind to the weak.

text: But Vietnamese sayings aren't always kind to cats.
shown: But Vietnamese sayings aren't always kind to cats.

text: "When a cat comes to your house, hard times come. When a dog comes, wealth comes."
shown: "When a cat comes to your house, hard times come. When a dog comes, wealth comes."

text: And an old belief warned: never let a cat jump over a body before burial... or the dead might sit up.
shown: And an old belief warned: never let a cat jump over a body before burial... or the dead might sit up.

text: The same animal that guarded the rice could also frighten the village.
shown: The same animal that guarded the rice could also frighten the village.

text: So Vietnam didn't choose the cat because it was cute.
shown: So Vietnam didn't choose the cat because it was cute.

text: It chose an animal from real village life.
shown: It chose an animal from real village life.

text: Useful, clever, powerful... a little scary.
shown: Useful, clever, powerful... a little scary.

text: That's a pattern you'll see across Vietnamese culture: borrow a system from China, then fill it with your own world.
shown: That's a pattern you'll see across Vietnamese culture: borrow a system from China, then fill it with your own world.

text: It's what makes Vietnam part East Asian, part Southeast Asian, and completely its own.
shown: It's what makes Vietnam part East Asian, part Southeast Asian, and completely its own.

text: So check your birth year.
shown: So check your birth year.

text: If you're a rabbit in Beijing... you're a cat in Hanoi.
shown: If you're a rabbit in Beijing... you're a cat in Hanoi.

text: Vietnam's next Tet, on February 6, 2027, opens the Year of the Goat.
shown: Vietnam's next Tet, on February 6, 2027, opens the Year of the Goat.

text: And the next Year of the Cat is 2035.
shown: And the next Year of the Cat is 2035.

text: The zodiac is just one place where Vietnam sits between two Asias.
shown: The zodiac is just one place where Vietnam sits between two Asias.
